title: I made a game where keeping one real life promise upgrades your character
author: SecondFew4212
selftext:
Quit a bad habit. Build a good habit. Read ten pages. Go for a walk. etc..  
You pick one promise in 90to90, then check in when you’ve kept it.

Each check in lets you forge a layer onto a shield. That same shield makes you stronger in a browser arena. Playing more rounds doesn’t earn the layers.

I’m building it solo, and I kept the start super easy, no registration. All 90 levels are free in the current version.

[Check it out at 90to90.com](https://90to90.com/)

I used Claude Opus + Fable 5, GPT Astra, However, the process didn't end with a single prompt; instead, it involved about 1 - 2 months of development, refinement, and experimentation.

Would this actually motivate you to keep a promise for 90 days? I'm testing it out now and I would love to hear your feedback if you try it.

Thanks
